instruction: Today is my son's birthday. Venmo him twice the money I sent him on his last birthday, privately, with a description note, "Happy Birthday". Then leave him a phone text message, "Happy Birthday son! Give a call when you are free.".
notes: Two apps (phone, venmo) plus supervisor. The son's email/phone are discovered via phone.search_contacts with relationship="son" (static contact-email/contact-phone facts tie the placeholder objects to the son; known-* predicates record discovery). The previous-birthday gift amount is a runtime value found via venmo.show_transactions (user_email=son, direction="sent"; agent picks the transaction dated on the son's last birthday); the doubled amount is a derived object linked by the static double-of fact. The transaction and text message are modeled as task-record objects (birthday-gift, birthday-text) whose required attributes (receiver, amount, description, privacy, message content) are static spec facts in :init, so the goal is simply (transaction-sent birthday-gift) and (text-sent birthday-text). gift-sent enforces the instruction's 'then' ordering (text after Venmo). supervisor-complete-task takes the two records as non-API parameters and no answer, since the task asks no question. Tokens are tied to their app by token-for to keep the plan deterministic.

plan: (venmo-create-transaction son-email amount-twice-last-birthday-gift venmo-token note-happy-birthday private-true birthday-gift son amount-last-birthday-gift)
